patch_description:
This constructor replaces the ring heuristic with a topology-guided nonlinear packing search. It starts from several asymmetric five-row layouts, especially layouts containing one or two denser six-circle rows, because these exploit the square boundary more effectively than a fully symmetric grid.

For each candidate row topology, the program jointly optimizes all circle centers and radii using constrained SLSQP optimization. The objective is the total radius, while constraints enforce square containment and every pairwise non-overlap condition. A final certification pass uniformly shrinks radii only if required by floating-point tolerance, ensuring the returned packing is valid.
